title: Microstructure Modifcation and Ductility Improvement for TaMoNbZrTiAl Refractory High Entropy Alloys via Increasing Ti Content
process_description: prepared by non-consumable arc melting utilizing a water-cooled copper crucible. Each alloy button was melted, flipped and remelted at least five times to achieve chemical homogeneity with the protection of argon atmosphere. Annealing treatment was carried out in a high vacuum heat treatment furnace full of flowing Ar gas at 1300 °C for 48 h, followed by furnace cooling.
